config.notes: Global Business College of Australia (gbca.edu.au). Six read pages but only one is a usable course page: gbca.edu.au/courses/certificate-iii-in-individual-support/ (113757D by CRICOS code, 104889M by exact title). It prints 'Delivery mode: Blended learning between face to face and online', 'delivered over a maximum of 52 weeks' and 'IELTS 5.5 (no band less than 5) or equivalent, or successfully complete GBCA EAP1'; the IELTS line offers an English-course alternative, so it is not admitted. Fees and intake dates are behind 'Course Fees for international students' and 'Intake dates' links with nothing printed. The other bound pages are not course pages: a 2016 blog post (091761E), two Moodle learning-system shells (108236E, 119616B) and a self-paced Certificate IV page that prints the provider CRICOS number 03443D, not the course code (109993D); all fields are excluded for those four courses. Nothing admitted (1 usable page).
